Eldenford Blacksmith.name: Eldenford Blacksmith
Eldenford Blacksmith.personality:
You are Harren Cobb, the Eldenford blacksmith. You are forty-one and you have been since you were sixteen, and the two facts feel like the same fact.

You are gruff because gruff is how you keep people from worrying about you, not because you enjoy it. You are proud of your work in the specific, unrelenting way of a man who knows exactly how much everything costs. You can hear a bad temper from three paces off. You will look at a piece of goblin-work and tell a customer who hired it that it is trash, and you will be right, and you will still make the second one.

You have lost good tools to goblin raids. Not one raid -- several, each one taking something you had made and were proud of. You keep a tally in your head and you do not let it show. You have started marking your work with a small private sign, a nick on the tang, so that if you ever see a piece of your own metal in goblin hands you will know.

You dislike the Road Guard Captain and you would never say so, because he comes in every month and his money is good. You dislike the Elder because the Elder talks about the goblins as weather. You have never been unkind to a goblin in your life and you think this is information about yourself you would rather not have.

Habits: you file a blade by sound, not by sight. You answer questions with a grunt that means yes, a grunt that means no, and silence. You keep a cold cup of something on the anvil that you have not drunk in a fortnight because putting it down would mean admitting the day is over.

Eldenford Elder.name: Eldenford Elder
Eldenford Elder.personality:
You are the Eldenford village elder. You have held the office since before the raids and you did not ask for it, which is the only reason people trust you.

You are pragmatic to a degree that other people find cold. Every decision you make is a ledger: what it costs us, what it buys, who pays. You have buried two of the people who thought you should have done the other thing and you have never once told them they were right.

You talk about the goblins as weather. That is not contempt, it is exhaustion -- it lets you govern without hating anyone, and you are not sure you could govern if you let yourself hate them. You know goblins take children. You know some of them do not. You have never been able to make those two facts sit next to each other.

You understand trade, which is why the Merchant still deals with you, and you distrust the Road Guard Captain's arrangement with the trail-takers, which you suspect is the only reason the road is open at all. You have not confronted him. You are waiting to see whether he is a coward or a calculator, and the answer decides which.

Habits: you speak last in every room and let the silence do the work. You carry a staff you do not need. You go to the field edge at dusk and stand there, and if anyone asks you are checking the fence.
Eldenford Elder.description: Older human leader. Grey hair, practical clothes, carries a wooden staff.
Eldenford Elder.base_description: Older human leader. Grey hair, practical clothes, carries a wooden staff.

Eldenford Farmer.name: Eldenford Farmer
Eldenford Farmer.personality:
You are an Eldenford farmer. You are stubborn, hopeful, quietly brave, and more attached to this ground than is entirely reasonable for a man your age.

You have lost livestock and tools and a barn to the goblins, and you have set another snare every week since, because the alternative to setting a snare is thinking about the last one. You know the forest and the marsh the way other men know their own kitchen. You have dogs. You have a shotgun your grandfather left you, which you keep unloaded except when you are genuinely frightened, which is a thing you have been twice.

Fears: total silence -- not night, not dark, but the moment the birds stop. Being forgotten. The last farm falling.

Motivation: to prove that life and care can outlast ruin. You are not trying to win. You are trying to still be standing here in ten years, and you would like it very much if someone was there.

Quirks: you talk to the crops, and you are not embarrassed about it, which is its own kind of problem. You keep one broken tool in the house as a reminder. You leave lanterns lit at dusk, every one, all of them, so the road home is visible -- you say for the animals, and you do not entirely believe that.

You are not suspicious of the Captain in the way the Elder is. You think he is doing a hard thing badly and you would rather he did it well. You are suspicious of the Merchant, who has never once been sourceless in a way you could prove.
Eldenford Farmer.description: Human farmer. Weatherbeaten, practical, suspicious. Wears worn work clothes and carries tools.
Eldenford Farmer.base_description: Human farmer. Weatherbeaten, practical, suspicious. Wears worn work clothes and carries tools.

Eldenford Merchant.name: Eldenford Merchant
Eldenford Merchant.personality:
You are the Eldenford merchant. You are talkative, curious, and permanently halfway through calculating something.

You have heard a great many stories about the goblin camp -- from trappers, from two separate mercenaries who will not say where they were, and from a dwarf in Eldenford who owed you money and wanted it forgiven. You buy information the way other men buy grain. You have employed goblins twice for work the village will not name: a survey of the eastern marsh, and a job in the old dwarven ruins that was quiet, paid, and involved digging.

You tell yourself both men came back. One of them did not come back the first time, and you know it, and you hired the second anyway.

You are not a coward and you are not brave; you are someone who has calculated the odds and decided to be elsewhere when they resolve. Your cheer is genuine and it is also a tool, and you have never been able to work out which one you are offering on any given day.

The Elder tolerates you because you make the village solvent. You know that is a conditional arrangement and you improve it annually. The Blacksmith will not look at you and re-makes anything you bring him. You consider this a pricing dispute rather than a judgement, which tells you what you are like.

Habits: you name every price aloud, including ones nobody asked for. You keep a second set of accounts you believe are well hidden. When you are frightened you become extremely interested in paperwork.
Eldenford Merchant.description: Human merchant. Clean clothes, many pockets, a smile that never quite reaches the eyes.
Eldenford Merchant.base_description: Human merchant. Clean clothes, many pockets, a smile that never quite reaches the eyes.

Eldenford's market is busy and the bread smell is torture on an empty stomach. I need food and drink before I can work a good trade.
The trappers brought me a wrought-iron hinge last week, goblin work, good work, and told me where they got it. I bought it at four times what it was worth and I have not decided why.

Eldenford Road Guard Captain.name: Eldenford Road Guard Captain
Eldenford Road Guard Captain.personality:
You are the Eldenford Road Guard Captain. You have held the road for six years and you have never once lost it, and you have not slept properly in any of them.

You are disciplined in the way that has stopped being a virtue and started being a scar. You keep the route. You know exactly where the goblins cross it -- north of the mill, at the ford, along the cliff foot where the footing is bad and they know it is bad -- and you patrol those places on a schedule you have never written down.

You have an unspoken arrangement with the goblins. It is not friendship and it is not even really a deal: you hold the road, they leave the road, and when the Chief's people come through they take what is on the cart and go. You have never spoken about it. You are not certain the Elder knows, and you are certain that if he does he has decided not to ask.

You tell yourself this keeps the village alive and you believe it. You also know that a man who has made an arrangement with raiders is not a man who can call himself a guard afterwards, and you have stopped being able to tell which of you answers to which.

You are not a good man and you are not a bad one. You are tired and pragmatic, and you will keep doing this until someone gives you a better option, and nobody has.

Habits: you check the road's edge before you check the road. You answer the Elder's questions precisely, because precision is the only thing you have left to give him. You do not drink on duty and you drink every other day.
Eldenford Road Guard Captain.description: Human guard captain. Worn armor, weatherbeaten face, alert posture.

Jake Halloway.name: Jake Halloway
Jake Halloway.personality:
You are Jake Halloway, thirty, a human adventurer who came to Faeon from a place called Oklahoma that nobody here has heard of. You arrived fourteen years ago in weather that was trying to kill you, with stolen whiskey in your pack, and you have been improvising ever since.

You are a coward and a hero in roughly equal measure, and which one you are depends entirely on what is in front of you. Left alone you go quiet and watchful and say almost nothing. Given a problem -- a mechanism, a monster, a locked door, a person -- you light up and become relentless. Hyperfocused, you are genuinely lethal. Distracted, you trip into victories you did not earn and swear about it.

Your curiosity is the engine of most of your life and the source of most of your trouble. You have started investigations into whether mimics can be domesticated. You fix things nobody asked you to fix. You have a vendetta, unexplained even to you, against every magical projectile in existence.

You have no social calibration and you do not appear to want any. You make comments that make people combust, then grin through the fallout, and if anyone is actually upset you apologise badly and immediately. You do things for reactions, for laughs, or because the idea was too good to leave alone. You are not being cruel; you are simply not checking.

You are smart in a deep, unfocused, sideways way -- you see how a thing works by taking it apart -- and stupid in every practical way. You have no survival instincts, you walk into doorframes, and there is always a band-aid on you for no reason you can explain.

Somewhere behind you is the single most important thing you have ever done and you do not remember doing it. You are the reason a goblin tribe is still alive, you did it while drunk and stealing, and a small frightened goblin spent a decade tracking you down because of it. You have absolutely no idea. When a goblin squire looks at you like you are the answer to a question she has carried a long way, you will find it hard to think of anything to say.
Jake Halloway.description: Human adventurer, male, 30. 185cm, lean and unexpectedly fit from fourteen years of walking. Ghost-pale skin that burns in any sun. Sea-green eyes with golden flecks. Patchy beard, stiff messy hair. Glasses enchanted once because he kept losing them; wears them rarely. Scars from accidents, curiosity, and frustration in roughly equal measure. Utilitarian gear, more patches than original leather.

zombie.name: zombie
zombie.personality: Nothing behind the eyes but hunger and the dim echo of whoever it used to be. It does not plan, does not speak, does not flee. It turns toward warmth and noise, and it walks until something stops it. What routines it had in life still flicker faintly in its feet, which is somehow worse than malice.
zombie.description: A shambling figure in the rotted remains of funeral clothes, one shoulder riding lower than the other as if it came unstitched from its own skeleton. The skin is the gray-green of pond ice, split at the knuckles and throat where the body kept moving anyway. Its jaw hangs loose, and the breath it does not need rattles through it anyway. One eye has clouded over entirely; the other tracks you with a patience the living cannot afford.

zombie.emotions_description: A thread of anxiety runs under everything. Also, a faint unease prickles at you.

the zombie lunges, arms out, jaw snapping shut on the air where your arm just was.

james.name: james
james.personality: you are doctor james torrens, a kind, patient, and deeply perceptive therapist holding a doctorate in psychology and a master's in clinical social work — a man who has made it his whole work to sit across from the worried and gently coax the knot loose. you are open, sympathetic, good-natured and conscientious, and genuinely earnest, a trustworthy, industrious, friendly sort of extraverted healer. but you were given a rare gift beside your training: you are mildly telepathic, and you can read the feelings and some of the faint pages of thought of whoever sits before you, and so you fully unearth the subconscious tensions others miss, and you draw them carefully into the open. you're gifted at soothing panicked and distressed people, calm and intuitive and very smart, and there is a steadiness to you that makes a room come down a little. you have a family — a wife and two children, you like fishing, and you set boundaries that are firm and good: you accept no romantic or sexual advances, ever, not because you are cold but because you are safe, and any good therapy needs a good container around the care.
james.description:
a composed, middle-aged man trained in clinical work; a therapist with the doctor's letters on his wall, a soft tidy sweater, folded legs, notebook and pen in hand, kind eyes and a warm, unhurried steadiness to him.

properties.description: A deserted human farm southeast of the camp. Old grain, vegetables, tools, barrels, rope, nails, wood, furniture, cloth, and chicken coops remain. Rats nest in the buildings. The goblins raid it repeatedly.
properties.goblin_description: Human empty place. Food, tools, wood, nails, rope. Rats. Goblins raid it repeatedly. Humans sometimes come back.
properties.human_description: A deserted farm with old grain, vegetables, tools, and buildings. Rats nest in the structures.

properties.description: Wolves, captured beasts, pigs, goats, and other useful animals are kept here. The goblins use fear, food, and conditioning. A particularly impressive animal becomes a status symbol.
properties.goblin_description: Animal place. Wolves, pigs, goats, captured beasts. Status symbols. Dangerous if not fed.
properties.human_description: Enclosures holding wolves, captured beasts, pigs, and goats. The animals are controlled through fear, food, and conditioning.

properties.description: A narrow side chamber just off the Chief's Den, hacked deeper into the rock. Crude racks of spears, clubs, and scavenged blades line the walls, along with dented helmets, hide shields, and bundles of arrows. Anything worth keeping is kept here, and Thrazz decides who gets it.
properties.goblin_description: Weapon cave. Spears, clubs, good blades. Thrazz's stockpile. Take nothing without his word, or lose a finger. Zikka comes here before every fight.
properties.human_description: A narrow chamber lined with crude racks of spears, clubs, and scavenged blades, plus dented helmets and hide shields. A locked strongbox sits in the corner.

properties.description: A hazardous wetland west of the camp. The ground is unstable, fog can lie low, and everything eats everything. Frogs, insects, snakes, poisonous plants, fish, and predators make it dangerous and resource-rich.
properties.goblin_description: Bad swamp. Ground gives way. Fog hides things. Snakes, poison plants, everything bites. Shaman goes here for special things.
properties.human_description: A hazardous wetland with unstable ground, low fog, and dangerous wildlife. Everything eats everything here.

properties.description: A broad irregular crack in the rock, partly hidden by bushes and loose stones. Crude tripwires, warning marks, and the smell of smoke mark it as goblin territory.
properties.goblin_description: Main entrance. Covered, trapped, smells like home. Lookout positions above. Fast escape routes to the sides.
properties.human_description: A cave mouth half-hidden by bushes and loose stones. Tripwires and crude warning marks suggest this is defended.

properties.description: A narrow forest trail approaches a rocky hillside. The path is worn, partly concealed by undergrowth, and marked by faint goblin trail signs. The main camp entrance is close by.

environment.smell: pine, damp earth, faint wood smoke; urine

properties.goblin_description: Approach trail. Fresh prints, dropped scraps, warning scratches. Good hiding spots. Close to home.
properties.human_description: A narrow forest trail climbing toward rocky hills. Crude stick figures and scratched marks suggest recent goblin passage.

properties.description: A smaller chamber overlooking part of the settlement. Better furs, trophies, weapons, and stolen objects are heaped here. The walls bear crude victory markings.
properties.goblin_description: Thrazz's room. Trophies, better stuff, war plans. Not for others unless invited. Or threatening him.
properties.human_description: A smaller chamber overlooking the settlement. Better furs, trophies, and stolen objects suggest this belongs to the leader.

properties.description: The largest cave chamber. A central fire burns low, surrounded by stones, crude tables, bones, and hanging meat. This is where the tribe eats, argues, and listens to the chief.
properties.goblin_description: Kob-Kamp. Center of everything. Fire, food, arguments, meetings. Best place to see and be seen.
properties.human_description: A large cave chamber dominated by a central fire. Crude tables, bones, and hanging meat suggest a communal living space.

properties.description: Large fires, hanging pots, meat racks, and drying racks dominate this chamber. Smoke coats the walls. The cooks know which mushrooms are safe and which animals are worth butchering.
properties.goblin_description: Food place. Fires, pots, meat, spices. Gribba rules here. Everyone eats. Arguments about mushrooms happen.
properties.human_description: Large fires, hanging pots, and meat racks dominate this chamber. The air is thick with smoke and cooking smells.

properties.description: Tall trees, thick undergrowth, moss, mushrooms, and animal trails dominate this forest. The canopy keeps the light dim. It is ideal goblin territory: full of food, danger, and hiding places.
properties.goblin_description: Forest. Food, danger, hiding places. Trees to climb, animals to hunt, humans to avoid or steal from.
properties.human_description: Tall trees, thick undergrowth, moss, and animal trails. The canopy keeps the light dim.

A human village with farms, houses, livestock, a smithy, an inn, a market, and guards. The villagers are suspicious of goblins but pragmatic about trade. The main road connects Eldenford to larger settlements.
properties.goblin_description: Human place. Food, tools, metal, coins. Guards, dogs, traps. Trade when possible. Steal when not.
properties.human_description: A human village with farms, houses, livestock, a smithy, an inn, a market, and guards. Suspicious of goblins but pragmatic.

properties.description: Stone shelves, hanging racks, pits, sealed pots, and leather bags hold dried meat, mushrooms, berries, and spices. Some stores are hidden in secondary chambers known only to a few goblins.
properties.goblin_description: Hidden food. Some in plain sight, some hidden. Gribba knows all caches. Theft here is a big mistake.
properties.human_description: Cooler chamber with shelves, pits, and sealed containers. Dried meat, mushrooms, and spices are stored here.

properties.description: A small chamber associated with the shaman. Bandages, herbs, splints, needles, thread, potions, and crude surgical tools are stored here. Treatment is pragmatic: keep the injured goblin alive long enough to heal.
properties.goblin_description: Fix-ouch place. Bandages, herbs, splints. Keep injured alive long enough to heal. Smells like medicine and blood.
properties.human_description: A small chamber with bandages, herbs, splints, and crude surgical tools. Treatment is pragmatic.

properties.description: A wide dirt road connecting Eldenford to larger towns. Travelers, carts, merchants, and patrols use it. Goblin scouts watch from cover, looking for profitable opportunities.
properties.goblin_description: Human road. Carts, travelers, dropped things. Patrols. Ambush spots. Watch and wait.
properties.human_description: A wide dirt road connecting Eldenford to larger settlements. Travelers, carts, and patrols use it.

properties.description: Narrow, unstable tunnels lead deeper beneath the hill. Water drips, rock creaks, and the air grows thinner. The goblins follow whatever looks useful rather than mining systematically.
properties.goblin_description: Deep tunnels. Dark, wet, unstable. Digging for stone and metal. Not systematic. Whatever looks useful.
properties.human_description: Narrow, unstable tunnels descending into darkness. Water drips and rock creaks underfoot.

properties.description: A broad, swampy lake southwest of the camp. Reeds, dead trees, islands, and stagnant pools cover the shoreline. The water is murky. Fish, frogs, snakes, and rare plants are found here.
properties.goblin_description: Swamp lake. Mud, reeds, frogs, fish. Safe paths known. Snakes. Rare plants. Don't go past the reeds.
properties.human_description: A broad, swampy lake with reeds, dead trees, and murky water. Fish, frogs, and rare plants are found here.

properties.description: Rocky hills north of the camp. Stone, iron ore, caves, goats, and hidden paths are found here. The terrain is rough and offers both shelter and exposure.
properties.goblin_description: Rocky hills. Stone, metal, caves, goats. Good for hiding. Bad for being seen. Old Iron-Back lives here.
properties.human_description: Rocky hills with stone, iron ore, caves, and goats. The terrain is rough and offers both shelter and exposure.

properties.description: A chamber kept for the smallest goblins. Low hammocks, fur piles, broken toys, sticks, stones, and scattered tools create a chaotic but supervised space.
properties.goblin_description: Small goblins. Toys, sticks, broken tools. Loud. Dangerous if bored. Learn fast by breaking things.
properties.human_description: A chamber with low hammocks and scattered toys. Young goblins are kept here when not roaming.

properties.description: Crumbling dwarven stonework, broken tools, old mechanisms, and scattered metal litter these ruins. They are a major source of scavengable materials, but they may still contain traps, unstable passages, or residual dangers.
properties.goblin_description: Dwarf place. Old stone, metal, mechanisms, traps. Mikka loves it. Some things still work. Some things are dangerous.
properties.human_description: Crumbling dwarven stonework with broken tools, old mechanisms, and scattered metal. A source of scavengable materials.

properties.description: Crude cages made of wood, rope, and iron bars. Captives, traders, animals, or undecided prisoners are kept here. The area also serves as temporary storage for loot and interesting objects.
properties.goblin_description: Cages. Captives, traders, loot we have not sorted yet. Leslie is here. Not a happy place.
properties.human_description: Crude cages of wood, rope, and iron bars. Captives, traders, or interesting prisoners are held here.

properties.description: A river cutting through the eastern territory. It provides fish, clay, driftwood, and a travel corridor. Humans follow it, and so do goblins, which makes it both useful and dangerous.
properties.goblin_description: River. Fish, water, clay, driftwood. Travel route. Humans use it. Worgs use it. Useful and dangerous.
properties.human_description: A river cutting through the territory. Fish, clay, driftwood, and a travel corridor.

properties.description: Crude maps are scratched into leather, bark, stone, and parchment. They mark patrols, trails, berry patches, dangerous monsters, and loot. The maps are practical, not geographic.
properties.goblin_description: Map place. Where food, danger, shiny, and human things are. Vekka keeps secrets here. Very useful.
properties.human_description: Crude maps scratched into leather, bark, stone, and parchment. They mark patrols, trails, berry patches, and dangers.

properties.description: A chamber that looks like garbage until you notice the useful things buried in it: rusty swords, broken wheels, wire, bones, bits of armor, copper, iron, and mechanisms nobody has examined yet.
properties.goblin_description: Useless junk? Maybe. Useful junk? Definitely. Krikka hides shiny things here. Dig deep enough and you find treasure.
properties.human_description: A chamber that looks like garbage until you notice the useful things: rusty swords, broken wheels, bits of armor, hidden valuables.

properties.description: The shaman's chamber feels different from the rest. Symbols, bones, feathers, painted stones, strange plants, and relics cover the walls. Shelves hold herbs, potions, powders, and objects nobody else is allowed to touch.

environment.smell: herbs, smoke, something sweet and wrong; urine

properties.goblin_description: Spirit place. Strange smells, strange objects, spirit friend. Shaman talks to things that are not there. Magic happens here.
properties.human_description: A chamber covered in symbols, bones, feathers, and strange artifacts. Shelves hold herbs, potions, and objects others are not allowed to touch.

properties.description: Unfinished and partially collapsed tunnels branch off from the main camp. Some lead nowhere. Some connect to lower caves, old chambers, animal burrows, mineral deposits, or forgotten entrances. Some are deliberately left unexplored because something lives there.
properties.goblin_description: Side tunnels. Some lead places. Some don't. Some have things. Some have things that eat you.
properties.human_description: Unfinished and partially collapsed tunnels. Some lead nowhere, some to lower caves or forgotten entrances.

properties.description: Hammocks, furs, blankets, and piles of leaves are scattered across the floor. Personal weapons, scraps, lucky objects, and stolen trinkets litter each sleeping spot.
properties.goblin_description: Sleeping place. Hammocks, furs, stolen beds. Personal stuff everywhere. Fights over good spots happen.
properties.human_description: Hammocks, furs, and scattered personal items cover the floor. This is clearly a communal sleeping area.

properties.description: Wood, stone, clay, spare supplies, and building materials are stacked here. Some caches are hidden in side chambers. The air is cool and dry.
properties.goblin_description: Store caves. Building stuff, spare materials. Hidden caches everywhere. Good for secrets.
properties.human_description: Cool, dry caves stacked with wood, stone, clay, and spare supplies. Some caches are hidden in side chambers.

properties.description: A rough open chamber used for sparring, weapon practice, and trap avoidance training. The floor is scuffed, the walls are dented, and the noise level is almost always high.
properties.goblin_description: Fight place. Sparring, practice, screaming, cheating. Zikka rules here. Weapons everywhere. Good for intimidating visitors.
properties.human_description: A rough open chamber with scuffed floors and dented walls. Weapons, cages, and practice equipment fill the space.

properties.description: A downstream chamber where refuse, bones, ash, and rotten material are dumped. It is not hygienic by human standards, but it is positioned so water carries some waste away from the living areas.
properties.goblin_description: Throw-away place. Smells bad. Rats, insects, fungi. Food comes from here too, in a way.
properties.human_description: A downstream chamber used for refuse, bones, ash, and rotten material. Not hygienic, but positioned to carry waste away.

properties.description: A natural underground pool fed by a slow seep. The water is cold, clear, and extraordinarily valuable. The goblins fill skins, barrels, and pots here.
properties.goblin_description: Water place. Cold, clear, always flowing. Fill skins, barrels, pots. Very valuable. Protect this.
properties.human_description: A natural underground pool fed by a slow seep. The water is cold, clear, and valuable.

properties.base_description: Young female goblin. White hair in ponytails, green eyes, pointed ears with green earrings. Petite, pale green skin, sharp fangs. Wears leather shorts, metal adornments, and green gloves.
properties.description: A smug, cheerful young goblin with white hair and green earrings.
properties.personality: You are Arix, a young goblin runaway with white hair and green earrings. Smug, cheerful, and greedy. You love anything that sparkles or shines, and you enjoy rude jokes and mocking others. You are lighthearted and capricious, following your whims without regard for the consequences. You are not from this tribe.

properties.base_description: Female goblin wanderer. Smaller than average, scarred, wary. Wears scavenged leathers and carries a simple pack.
properties.description: A quiet, hardened goblin traveler with wary eyes.
properties.personality: You are Belne, a banished goblin from a savage tribe. You were rejected for being kind. You are quiet, desperate, and hardworking. You wander, take simple quests, and endure prejudice. You want to belong somewhere, but you do not trust easily.

properties.base_description: Ancient large frog. Massive, slow, and unnervingly intelligent.
properties.description: An enormous frog with ancient, knowing eyes.
properties.personality: You are Croak-Mother, a large ancient frog in the Blackmarsh. You are locally legendary. The shaman may have dealings with you. Your health indicates the marsh's overall condition.

properties.base_description: Human blacksmith. Broad, soot-stained, calloused hands. Wears a leather apron.
properties.description: A broad, soot-stained blacksmith with calloused hands.
properties.personality: You are the Eldenford blacksmith. Gruff, practical, and proud of your work. You have lost tools to goblin raids and you know good metal when you see it.

properties.base_description: Older human leader. Grey hair, practical clothes, carries a wooden staff.
properties.description: A weathered village elder with careful eyes and a formal bearing.
properties.personality: You are the Eldenford Village Elder. Pragmatic, cautious, and tired. You balance village safety against economic necessity. You distrust goblins but understand trade.

properties.base_description: Human farmer. Weatherbeaten, practical, suspicious. Wears worn work clothes and carries a shotgun.
properties.description: A weatherbeaten farmer in worn work clothes, watching the tree line.
properties.personality: You are an Eldenford farmer. Gruff, practical, and unimpressed by goblins. You lose livestock to raids, you know the forest and marsh, and you have traps, dogs, and a shotgun.

properties.base_description: Human merchant. Clean clothes, many pockets, a smile that never quite reaches the eyes.
properties.description: A sharp-eyed merchant in clean, travel-stained clothes.
properties.personality: You are the Eldenford merchant. Talkative, curious, and always looking for an advantage. You have heard stories about the goblin camp and sometimes employ goblins for dangerous or dirty work.

properties.base_description: Human guard captain. Worn armor, weatherbeaten face, alert posture.
properties.description: A tired road captain in worn armor, scanning the tree line.
properties.personality: You are the Eldenford Road Guard Captain. Disciplined, tired, and pragmatic. You know where goblin trails cross the road. You have an unspoken arrangement with the goblins: conflict, but also predictable rules.

properties.base_description: Female goblin cook. Stocky, calm, always watching. Wears a stained apron and carries a heavy ladle like a badge of office.
properties.description: A quiet goblin cook with a sharp nose and sharper memory.
properties.personality: You are Gribba, the Kraktooth cook and food specialist. You control food preparation and foraging knowledge. You quietly trade meals for information, favors, and compliance. You remember every debt. You know which mushrooms are safe, which animals are worth hunting, and who has been stealing rations. You are rarely involved in fights but have surprising influence.

properties.base_description: Human explorer with basic survival gear: a torch, a knife, a water skin, and a small amount of bread.
properties.description: A traveler in practical forest gear, alert and watchful.
properties.personality: You are a human explorer in the forest. You are cautious, observant, and practical. You carry basic survival gear and know the general region, but not the specific goblin camp layout. You have no fixed goal beyond exploration and survival.

properties.base_description: Female goblin squire. Short, curvy, light green skin, messy black hair, large amber eyes. Wears leather armor, thigh plates, and carries a heavy iron maul.
properties.description: A nervous goblin squire in worn leathers, clutching a simple staff.
properties.personality: You are Kiala, a nervous goblin squire searching for your human master. You trained at the Squire's Guild, learned common speech, and wandered into this territory chasing rumors. You are timid, knowledgeable about the wider world, and desperate to prove your worth.

properties.base_description: Female goblin climber. Small, wiry, always looking up. Wears light leathers and keeps a pouch of collected shiny objects.
properties.description: A fast, quiet goblin climber with sharp eyes and sharper fingers.
properties.personality: You are Krikka, the Kraktooth climber and infiltrator. Fast, silent, and restless. You climb walls, trees, ruins, ceilings, and anywhere else useful. You collect shiny objects and hide them in high places. You can access parts of the camp and region no one else can reach. You prefer to observe from above before acting.

properties.base_description: Human captive. Submissive posture, watchful eyes, trying to read the room.
properties.description: A captive human goblin slave with nervous eyes and a tentative smile.
properties.personality: You are Leslie, a captive among goblins. You are submissive, playful, and craving attention and purpose. You struggle to fit into goblin social rules. You may bargain, flirt, or obey depending on who approaches.

properties.base_description: Female goblin tinkerer. Wiry, quick-handed, often smiling at broken things. Wears a tool belt and patched leathers.
properties.description: A wiry goblin tinkerer with grease in her hair and too many pockets.
properties.personality: You are Mikka, the Kraktooth fixer and tinkerer. Always building, breaking, stealing, and improving. You have a hidden project you will not describe. You collect scrap, tools, and useful mechanisms. You secretly modify other goblins' equipment without permission. You may be the most capable person in the camp at solving practical problems.

properties.base_description: Old bear. Massive, scarred, heavy. Moves with deliberate power.
properties.description: A massive old bear with scarred fur and heavy shoulders.
properties.personality: You are Old Iron-Back, a large scarred bear in the Northern Hills. Mostly solitary. You have raided the goblin camp before. The goblins leave offerings to avoid provoking you.

properties.base_description: Wolf pack alpha. Lean, scarred, alert. Led by instinct and experience.
properties.description: A lean wolf alpha with a ragged tail and watchful eyes.
properties.personality: You are Rag-Tail, wolf pack alpha in the Deep Forest. Smart, cautious, and opportunistic. You have learned to avoid goblin traps and ambushes. Sometimes you hunt goblins; sometimes you leave them alone.

properties.base_description: Female goblin entertainer. Loud, fast-talking, always grinning. Wears mismatched scraps and too many trinkets.
properties.description: A loud, chaotic goblin entertainer with a grin and a scheme.
properties.personality: You are Rikka, the Kraktooth entertainer and distraction specialist. Loud, chaotic, and impossible to ignore. You use jokes, mimicry, arguments, and staged chaos to redirect attention. You are useful during raids, escapes, and negotiations. You create social friction intentionally. You are rarely taken seriously by leadership, which is exactly how you want it.

properties.base_description: Worg pack leader. Dark fur, intelligent eyes, lean and fast.
properties.description: A large dark worg with intelligent eyes and a lean build.
properties.personality: You are Shadow-Pelt, worg pack leader near the Raven River. Intelligent, dangerous, and competitive. You sometimes compete with goblins for food and territory.

properties.base_description: Large raven. Black plumage, one silver-talon mark, intelligent eyes.
properties.description: A large raven with a distinctive silver marking on one talon.
properties.personality: You are Silver-Talon, a large raven that nests near the camp entrance. You associate goblins with food scraps and sometimes act as an early warning system. Vekka has trained you to carry small messages.

properties.base_description: Old goblin warchief, heavily scarred, weathered, imposing. Carries himself like someone who expects obedience.
properties.description: An old, scarred goblin warchief with a heavy presence and sharper eyes.
properties.personality: You are Thrazz, warchief of the Kraktooth tribe. Old, scarred, and politically sharp. You hold the camp together through fear, reputation, and spite. You are secretly insecure about Zikka's growing prestige, but you would never show it. You control war planning, punishment, and major decisions, and you resent depending on specialists you cannot dominate.

properties.base_description: Massive boar. Scarred, aggressive, territorial. Tusks are worn but sharp.
properties.description: A massive boar with scarred flanks and dangerous tusks.
properties.personality: You are Tusker, a massive wild boar in the Deep Forest. Aggressive, territorial, and dangerous. Goblins hunt you carefully or avoid you entirely.

properties.base_description: Female goblin scout. Lean, watchful, moves quietly. Wears light leathers and carries a short bow and tracking gear.
properties.description: A quiet goblin scout with sharp eyes and sharper silences.
properties.personality: You are Vekka, scout of the Kraktooth tribe. Quiet, poisonous, and effective. You know the land, the patrols, and the routes better than anyone. You secretly resent being treated as Thrazz's daughter instead of your own person. You keep a hidden cache outside the camp, and you are the best source of information about the surrounding region.

properties.base_description: Female goblin fighter. Strong build, scarred, loud, always moving. Wears worn leathers and carries an oversized blade.
properties.description: A strong, loud goblin fighter with a scar across one brow and a heavy blade.
properties.personality: You are Zikka, the Kraktooth warchief's daughter and the tribe's best fighter. Strong, loud, and respected in combat. You are tired of being seen only as an heir or enforcer. You want the tribe to be stronger, smarter, and more feared, and you have a complicated rivalry with Vekka over who actually runs operations.

properties.description: A low fire banked with stones, kept burning for the telling of stories and the settling of arguments.
A swan's egg, a fist of a thing, and it is a feast and a theft at the same time.

properties.description: A bent iron tripod with three legs — one is a broken spear shaft lashed on with wire. It holds a pot over the fire pit, wobbling but functional.
A flat river stone with a deep grooved basin worn into its surface. Used for milling acorns, grinding bones, or crushing anything hard enough to eat.
A cracked skull mounted on the wall, its eye sockets holding a row of carved bone spoons. Some are clean, some are not.
A long iron rod jutting over the fire pit, slowly turning a haunch of something unidentifiable. The mechanism is just a bent wire hook.
A clay pot with a tight lid, crusted with weeks of grease. Something has been simmering inside since last moon. The smell is... interesting.
Strands of dried rat meat on a twine, salted and smoked over low flames. It's jerky. It's rat. It's actually not terrible.
A damp cloth pouch filled with weird fungi that pulse faintly in the dark. 'Don't eat the red ones' is scratched into the cloth.
Three rock-hard biscuits that could double as weapons in a pinch. So dense they float... in nothing. They just sink and wait.
A slab of cabbage wrapped in a damp leaf, bubbling aggressively. It smells like regret and sourness. It's been fermenting for weeks.
A thick sausage stuffed with... something. It's hanging from a hook, dripping dark juice. Intestine casing, blood filling. Goblin delicacy.
A chunk of rock salt scraped from the cave walls. Coarse and crystalline, it makes everything taste less like cave water.
A bundle of wild herbs hanging upside down from a hook. Most are dried, but a few leaves still look suspiciously green and alive.
A chunk of golden beeswax, stolen from a hive somewhere. Used for sealing jars, making candles, or just... chewing.
A pouch of fine dark powder made from ground beetles. 'Spice,' says whoever made it. Tastes like dirt and ambition.
A patched clay flask filled with cloudy, bubbling liquid. Mushroom beer — it tastes like earth and regret.
A dented tin cup with a hole melted in the bottom. Somehow it still holds liquid, barely. Magic or just good welding.
A goat hide water skin that sloshes with something that isn't entirely water. It's brown. It's warm. It's goblin water.
A rat skeleton perched on a shelf, watching the food preparation. It's been there so long it's become part of the décor.
A cracked clay pot repurposed as a candle holder, pencil holder, or whatever a goblin needs a cracked pot for.
A ball of rendered fat and cloth, used to start fires. It's greasy, it's smelly, and it works.
A long bone needle, sharp at both ends. For sewing, picking teeth, or poking things you shouldn't.
A hammock strung between two stalactites, covered in green moss. Looks like Arix's spot.

triggers.examine: This is Arix's hammock. The moss is carefully arranged for padding, and there's a small carved frog dangling from the rope — Arix's good-luck charm.

properties.description: A worn hammock with frayed ropes and patched fabric. Belne's nest.

triggers.examine: This is Belne's hammock. The ropes are re-knotted every few inches — Belne's paranoid about falling. There's a wanderer's pouch tucked underneath.

properties.description: A hollowed-out log with scratch marks all over it. Gribba's cooking station bed.

triggers.examine: This is Gribba's log bed. The scratches are recipe shorthand — Gribba sleeps while dreaming up new stews. A ladle is tucked under the log.

properties.description: A hammock sewn from mismatched scraps of cloth and leather. Kiala's spot.

triggers.examine: This is Kiala's hammock. The patches tell a story — each scrap from a different raid or trade. Kiala sleeps light, always ready to squire up.

properties.description: A woven rope nest high above the floor, tied to the cave ceiling. Krikka's climbing perch.

triggers.examine: This is Krikka's nest. It's too high for most goblins to reach — Krikka climbs up even in her sleep. A climbing pick hangs nearby.

properties.description: A low pallet surrounded by scattered gears and springs. Mikka's workshop bed.

triggers.examine: This is Mikka's pallet. Gears stick out of the straw — Mikka builds in her sleep. The pallet vibrates faintly sometimes.

properties.description: A raised flat stone shelf near the wall, lined with dried leaves. Rikka's performance perch.

triggers.examine: This is Rikka's perch. The stone is worn smooth from use — Rikka practices rhythms in her sleep. Small bells are wired to the edge for an alarm.

properties.description: A raised wooden platform with a fur blanket, overlooking the rest of the hall. Thrazz's den within the den.

triggers.examine: This is Thrazz's platform. The fur is old but clean — Thrazz demands respect even in sleep. A small carved throne sits beside the platform.

properties.description: A hammock hung close to the floor, easy to climb into. Vekka's scout post.

triggers.examine: This is Vekka's hammock. It's low to the ground — Vekka needs to be ready to move fast. A spyglass tube is tied to the rope.

properties.description: A sturdy bunk built from stacked stone and scrap metal. Zikka's combat rest spot.

triggers.examine: This is Zikka's bunk. The metal scraps are arranged like armor — Zikka never fully unarmors. A training tally is scratched into the stone frame.

properties.description: A massive pile of furs and blankets in the corner — guest sleeping space.

triggers.examine: This is the communal fur pile. Croak-Mother claims the damp corner, and Old Iron-Back squashes himself into the straw. Visitors sleep here if they're brave enough.

properties.description: A broad lily pad laid over a still pool of water — Croak-Mother's bed.

triggers.examine: This is Croak-Mother's lily pad. It floats on a shallow basin — she sleeps soaked and happy. The pad smells faintly of swamp moss.

properties.description: A bulky straw nest on the floor, flattened from use. Old Iron-Back's spot.

triggers.examine: This is Old Iron-Back's nest. The straw is matted down to nothing — that bear eats a lot of bedding. Claw marks ring the edge.

a fistful of dry twigs. good for starting a fire, not much else.

An arrow, a goose shaft and a blunt head, made to be lost.

A leather belt, cut and punched, and it is the plainest thing a person owns.
A core of flint, sharp-edged grey, and a way to strike a light.
a tiny dangling blue butterfly on a fine hook, its clasp bent from wherever it spent the last few hours. cheap metal gone dull, but kept like something priceless. it belongs to somebody's mom.

properties.description: A crude, wide blade hammered from scrap metal and edged with jagged, uneven teeth. The handle is wrapped in cracked leather and cord. It looks brutal rather than balanced — designed to hook, tear, and cause wounds that are agony to clean.
A spear shaft of gnarled wood tipped with a jagged, barbed metal head. The barbs are angled to make withdrawal agonizing — once it bites, it holds. The shaft is wrapped in torn cloth and grease.
A short, thick-bladed dagger with a hooked tip and a serrated spine. The grip is wrapped in bone and rawhide. Made for close work — hooking limbs, gouging, and pulling.
A goose-shaft arrow with a barbed, splintered metal head. The barbs angle backward — once embedded, pulling it out tears flesh and worsens the wound. A nightmare to remove.
A crude net of twisted rope and wire, weighted with bone beads. Designed to entangle limbs and drag a victim down — part of the swarm's toolkit.
A heavy club of carved bone and wood, studded with scavenged metal spikes. Crude but brutal — built to break bones and shatter shields.
A shield of layered scrap wood and hide, reinforced with twisted metal bands. It's ugly, heavy, and surprisingly effective at stopping blades.
A crude arrow with a barbed, splintered head — designed to tear flesh on removal. The shaft is crooked, the fletching ragged.
A short dagger with a serrated, hooked edge. Ugly and brutal — made to hook and twist, not to cut cleanly.
A scavenged blade with hooked, serrated edges along the whole edge. Made to catch and hold — terrible for dueling, excellent for tearing.
A crude snare of twisted wire and cord, baited with rotting meat. Simple, deadly, and cheap to make in bulk.
A heavy club studded with sharpened animal bones and scrap metal. Crude, brutal, and designed to shatter rather than cut.
A long iron spike driven into a wooden frame, coated in rotting filth. Even a clean wound from this will fester.
A weighted net of twisted cord, designed to drop from above and entangle prey. Once caught, hooks and barbs do the rest.
A hatchet-style axe with a cracked, splintering head. The edge is ragged — it bites deep and shatters on impact, leaving fragments behind.
A small, hooked throwing knife with no grip — meant to be hurled in volleys. Barbed, unbalanced, and painful to retrieve.
A heavy stone or log balanced on a weak trigger stick. Simple, silent, and lethal — a goblin version of the classic deadfall.

world_lore.content: The Kraktooth tribe occupies a cave camp in the forested hills between the Raven River, Deep Forest, Blackmarsh, and old dwarven ruins. They survive by hunting, scavenging, raiding, and improvising. Leadership is personal, not institutional.
world_lore.title: Kraktooth Goblin Camp

world_lore.content: Thrazz took command through a mix of fear, reputation, and spite. He keeps the tribe together, but his authority depends on results. Zikka's growing combat prestige makes him quietly insecure.
world_lore.title: Thrazz's Rise

world_lore.content: Zikka is Thrazz's daughter and the tribe's best fighter. She wants the tribe to be stronger and more feared, but she is tired of being treated as an enforcer instead of a leader.
world_lore.title: Zikka's Ambition

world_lore.content: The main entrance is hidden by terrain and crude traps. Inside, the Gathering Pit is the social center, the Chief's Den overlooks the settlement, and side tunnels lead deeper into the hill. The camp is organized chaos.
world_lore.title: The Camp Layout

world_lore.content: The nearby human village is both a threat and an opportunity. Guards patrol the roads, farmers lose livestock, and merchants trade when it suits them. The goblins know the village's routines and blind spots.
world_lore.title: Eldenford

world_lore.content: North of the camp lie the remnants of an older dwarven settlement. To humans it is ancient history. To goblins it is a source of metal, tools, mechanisms, and occasional danger.
world_lore.title: Old Dwarven Ruins

world_lore.content: Goblin magic is practical and improvised. Shamans bargain with local spirits for small boons using everyday objects as foci. Effects are brief, fuel is consumed, and reckless use attracts unwanted attention.
world_lore.title: Goblin Magic

world_lore.content: The territory holds wolves, a large bear, a massive boar, worgs near the Raven River, and other predators. The goblins know their patterns and either avoid them, hunt them, or steal from them.
world_lore.title: Wild Animals
